value.subject: Preschool Swim start for Ada
value.body: Hello, I'm hoping to enroll Ada in Preschool Swim starting in January. I see that the site currently offers a session starting November 21, 2026, and a waitlist for a session starting January 9, 2027. Would it be possible for Ada to start in January rather than November? If a spot could be arranged, or if the January waitlist is the best option, I'd be grateful to hear how that works. Thank you very much for your help.
